fields.description: What this connection is called on screen.
fields.label: Name

fields.description: How the data arrives. Every kind runs the same pipeline; only the fetch differs.
fields.label: Kind

fields.description: Which protocol this stream speaks. Only a stream needs one: a file is identified from what is inside it.
fields.label: Dialect

fields.description: Lower wins where two sources disagree about the same line, stop or trip. The loser is kept and stays visible.
fields.label: Precedence

fields.description: In Files, or on a host connected there.
fields.label: Folder is

fields.description: Every file under it is read and identified on its own. Upload into it, or connect it to an SFTP, FTP, SMB or WebDAV host first — it makes no difference here.
fields.label: Folder

fields.description: Empty for the top of the mount. A subfolder where one authority drops several feeds.
fields.label: Path inside it

fields.description: A URL, or a socket address. Empty for a folder, which carries its own host.
fields.label: Endpoint

fields.description: Basic auth, for an endpoint that wants it.
fields.label: Username

fields.description: Zero for a source that pushes to us rather than being asked.
fields.label: Fetch every (minutes)

fields.description: The newest row this source has been read up to. What makes the next fetch incremental rather than whole. A folder does not use it: what a folder has already taken is written on the feeds themselves, one per file, so a delivery arriving late is still taken.
fields.label: Taken up to
